annotations.title: Report a problem with a transparent video

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. The builder's "Report a problem": opens a support ticket with the project's latest video and settings attached, so AlertForge support can look into it and refund where it was our fault. Free.
